plugins.name: rule-of-thumb-model
plugins.description: Spreadsheet models the rule-of-thumb way: agree the column contract, land raw data by SQL (Connected Sheets or Power Query), then model with short formulas (at most 2 nested functions), helper and checker cells and one style dictionary (Arial 8 or 9, grey headers, minimal colour). Commands: contract, build, theme, audit, check, compat, trace, split, lift, diff, document; four hooks.
